instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly enforce back button visibility: hidden on Home screen (index.tsx), visible on all nested/opened pages.
Implement 3 items per row grid on Home screen products using flex flex-row flex-wrap with item widths calc(33.33% - spacing) or 3-column layout.
Implement 2 items per row in subcategories next to the left vertical subcategory navigation bar.

Update theme.ts and departments.ts so Company Green (#174D37) is isolated to Home, while Food (Warm Sunset), Groceries (Fresh Botanical), Shops (Lavender), Care (Rose/Peachy), and Book It (Sky Cyan) render distinct pastel color palettes on screen header, backgrounds, and cards.
Add Bappa Ganesh Chaturthi festive theme animated banner connected to the collection search bar flow.
Expand brand spotlight to include multi-brand logos (Amul, Britannia, Nestle, Cadbury, Nandini, Nike, Nykaa) across Food, Groceries, and Shops.
Replace plain card toast on cart add with waving 3D character mascot overlay animation (cart-celebration.tsx).
Build complete working profile page (account.tsx) with profile edit, saved addresses, wishlist, refer & earn (copy/share code), and payment preferences.
Add explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-back-button', data-testid='product-card-add-button', data-testid='profile-edit-button') to all interactive components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain flat borders without padding.
Ensure high contrast compliance for all text placed on top of pastel backgrounds.
Ensure explicit hover and active press state styles on all buttons and cards.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements in kebab-case format.
